subject.title: fix(ui): chat popover layout test flakes under parallel load

question: Should a Control UI owner land this maintainer-labeled test-stability change after its behind-base review and exact-head UI proof are refreshed?
rationale: The patch is narrowly scoped and appears sound, but the protected `maintainer` label requires an explicit human merge decision rather than automated cleanup.

options.title: Refresh and land
options.body: Rebase or refresh the merge result, confirm the focused Control UI browser proof on that exact head, then land the targeted stabilization.

options.title: Pause for a different synchronization model
options.body: Hold the PR only if the UI owner identifies an existing test-harness wait primitive that better expresses the required layout boundary.

recommendation.title: Refresh and land
recommendation.body: Rebase or refresh the merge result, confirm the focused Control UI browser proof on that exact head, then land the targeted stabilization.
